items.headline: Lodha Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of unaudited financial results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
Lodha Q2 FY27 slides: PAT up 28%, margins expand despite revenue miss By Investing.com
Lodha Developers profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,013 crore in Sept quarter
items.summary: Lodha has announced a remarkable 63% surge in net profit, reaching ₹2,386 crore for the first half of FY27. This growth is driven by impressive operational performance, with net profit for the September quarter rising by 28% to ₹1,013 crore and revenue climbing 18% to ₹4,468 crore. The company’s pre-sales also saw a 10% increase to ₹5,037 crore, alongside plans for expansion in NCR and Bengaluru.

items.headline: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
items.summary: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.
